videos.desc: On a film set a young man gets his makeup done in a director's chair, steps to his mark in front of the camera, and after the clapperboard snaps he performs an intense, tearful scene straight into the lens; the crew applauds and he bows and celebrates.
In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a photographer shoots a model in a desert canyon while his assistant hands him the long lens, holds up the reflector, passes him a drink and gets a grateful thumbs-up.
videos.said: Long lens, please. Already here. Light, light. A bit left. You are the best.

videos.desc: An animated hotel cleaner in a lilac uniform pushes her cart with towels into a messy seaside room. She throws fresh sheets over the bed, fluffs pillows, sprays and wipes the window, vacuums the carpet and gives a proud thumbs up in the spotless room.

During a blackout, a woman in a hard hat and hi-vis vest works on an open fuse box in a dark hallway while a family lights the scene with phone flashlights. She snips wires, fits a new breaker and flips it, the lights come back on and everyone cheers.

In a night-time office a young worker with a badge lanyard hauls stacks of papers through his tasks as the clock spins. His silver-haired boss pats his shoulder, shakes his hand and hands him a pay envelope, and he celebrates with a coworker.
videos.said: Great month, Kenji. Thank you, boss! Payday! Let's go!

videos.desc: In an electronics lab a young man in glasses assembles a small robotic arm, tightens parts and types code on a laptop. The arm picks up a white cube and places it in a tray, and he pumps his fist while colleagues in lab coats applaud.

In a garage workshop, a bearded man in dark overalls works on a teal car: he checks the underside on the lift with a wrench, leans under the open hood, and unbolts a wheel hub with a power tool. He closes the hood, pats the car and smiles, job done.

On a cobblestone street at sunset, a red-haired young busker strums an acoustic guitar and sings to a circle of people. The crowd films him with their phones and applauds, and his open guitar case with coins lies at his feet.

In a carpentry workshop a young woman finishes a wooden chair, presses the seat to test it, puts her hands on her hips and admires it. She sits down, crosses her arms and beams with pride while an older colleague congratulates her.

A cheerful sailor in an orange jacket and life vest works on the deck of a wooden sailboat in a misty fjord: she winds a thick rope around a winch, laughs as spray bursts over the bow under the raised sails, then takes the ship's wheel and raises a fist in triumph.

In a recording studio, a young woman wearing headphones sings her heart out into a large studio microphone, one hand on her headphones, while producers work at the mixing desk behind the glass; she finishes the take laughing happily.

A young soldier in dress uniform walks through airport arrival doors with a duffel bag, spots his family waiting with a heart-painted sign, drops the bag and runs to them, ending in a big tearful group hug.

A construction worker hauls a heavy wooden crate up a narrow staircase onto a sunny rooftop, straining and wiping sweat from his face; after setting the crate down he slumps onto a step, arms hanging over his knees, panting and gasping "that's it."

A waitress in a cafe loads a wooden tray with coffee cups, a copper pot, glasses and cake, then carries it high overhead on one hand across the busy room, dodging a customer. She sets the fully loaded tray down on a table without spilling a drop and the guests applaud.
videos.said: Up high, steady. Not one drop.

videos.desc: A young man in a brown leather pilot jacket struts through an airport terminal past admiring cabin crew, then poses selfie-style in front of a huge jet engine at sunset, running a hand through his hair.

An animated mustachioed waiter in a bow tie dashes through a cozy restaurant balancing a tower of steaming plates on one hand. He weaves between tables, serves the dishes to delighted elderly guests and takes a proud little bow.
videos.said: That looks amazing! Enjoy your meal!

videos.desc: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.

A series of shots of tabby cats dressed in grey business suits living a full office life. Two of them sit side by side on the blue seats of a commuter train between human passengers. One types at a laptop in an open-plan office, walled in by towering stacks of paper. Two stand chatting with paper cups by the coffee machine and the water cooler. Two sit at a boardroom table watching a bar-chart presentation on a projector screen. In the last shot a cat in striped pyjamas works on a laptop in bed at night, surrounded by scattered documents.
videos.said: As you can see, the Q3 projections are quite stable.

videos.desc: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.

A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.

A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.

An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He lifts it up and tips it to look at its base, then screws a small brass eyeglass into his eye socket and studies the flowers painted on the side from a few centimetres away, turning the vase slowly in his gloved hands. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.
